classes.name: Batch
classes.description: One production run whose code is printed on the wrapper as its lot code; not a bean lot.

classes.name: BatchInput
classes.description: A measured quantity of one bean lot used in one batch.

classes.name: BeanLot
classes.description: A quantity of beans shipped and received together; may supply several production batches.

classes.name: Case
classes.description: A retailer complaint, customer inquiry, or nonconformance record.

classes.name: CaseInvestigation
classes.description: A dated investigation statement recorded within a case.

classes.name: CertificationRecord
classes.description: A supplier certification status record, including expired or explicitly absent certification.

classes.name: CocoarynthEntity
classes.description: An identified entity or recorded observation in the fictional Cocoarynth corpus.

classes.name: CollectionTicket
classes.description: A slip recording fresh beans delivered by a farm to a cooperative.

classes.name: Consignment
classes.description: An inbound shipment of bean lots, distinct from an outbound shipment of bars.

classes.name: Contract
classes.description: A recorded supplier buying agreement.

classes.name: Department
classes.description: A department within Cocoarynth.

classes.name: DepotStop
classes.description: One shipment's recorded custody and storage interval at a depot.

classes.name: Document
classes.description: One of the existing PDFs in the corpus manifest.

classes.name: Farm
classes.description: An identified cacao farm or estate parcel.

classes.name: FarmContribution
classes.description: One farm's contribution to a bean lot; wet and dried kilograms remain distinct.

classes.name: Finding
classes.description: An inspection finding with its recorded corrective action and status.

classes.name: Inspection
classes.description: A recorded farm inspection, certification inspection, or buyer visit.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: A named device recording temperature at a site.

classes.name: LotHold
classes.description: A recorded restriction on using a bean lot pending resolution of a quality problem.

classes.name: MarketPriceObservation
classes.description: The fictional commodity-price comparison for one year.

classes.name: Organization
classes.description: Cocoarynth or an organization with which it works.

classes.name: Origin
classes.description: A sourcing region and supplier, potentially involving several farms.

classes.name: Pallet
classes.description: An explicitly identified pallet in a shipment record.

classes.name: PanelSample
classes.description: One assessed sample in a sensory panel; a bench sample need not be a production batch.

classes.name: Partner
classes.description: An importer, forwarder, carrier, laboratory, certifier, or other business partner.

classes.name: Person
classes.description: A named fictional person in the corpus; not a customer-facing disclosure permission.

classes.name: PolicyRecord
classes.description: Structured receiving limits, storage guidance, or production parameters from the world data.

classes.name: PriceObservation
classes.description: An origin's landed bean cost per kilogram for one year.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: A bar formulation or sellable product, distinct from one production run.

classes.name: PurchaseObservation
classes.description: Recorded purchases from one origin for one year.

classes.name: QualityTest
classes.description: A dated moisture, cut-test, or sensory check of a bean lot.

classes.name: Retailer
classes.description: An organization buying bars from Cocoarynth; includes its overseas distributor.

classes.name: SalesObservation
classes.description: Monthly product sell-in to one retailer, not consumer sell-through.

classes.name: SensoryPanel
classes.description: A recorded tasting panel with an assessment method and coordinator.

classes.name: Shipment
classes.description: An outbound shipment of finished bars to a retailer.

classes.name: ShipmentLine
classes.description: A quantity of bars from one batch in an outbound shipment.

classes.name: Site
classes.description: A named facility or sublocation, such as a factory, room, depot, or storage bay.

classes.name: Supplier
classes.description: A cooperative, producer association, or estate supplying cacao.

classes.name: TemperatureReading
classes.description: One temperature observation at the logger's explicitly recorded offset.
